question: How well did patients do on meeting their followup goal?
audience: The people conducting the sessions can use this chart to see the progress of the patients
intended_claim: More visits is correlated with a higher goal met percentage
grain: The row should represent the number of visits and one point will show the goal met percentage per visit
text_alternative: This is a line graph that describes the patients' exercise goals in regards to their followup visits. The followup viist number is on the x-axis and the percentage of exercise goal reached is on the y-axis. The gap at follow up visit 4 shows a significant increase in center-based patients. patients chose their program, so the gap does not show that one program causes more exercise, and each percentage covers only the patients seen at that visit, about 45 per program, so a 9-point gap could also come from chance or from who returned
